offending_extra_words: IN NO EVENT SHALL EITHER PARTY'S TOTAL AGGREGATE LIABILITY FOR ANY MATTER ARISING UNDER OR RELATED TO THIS AGREEMENT
"EXCLUDED CLAIMS" MEANS A PARTY'S INDEMNIFICATION OBLIGATIONS UNDER SECTION 12
CLIENT'S OBLIGATION TO PAY COMPENSATION DUE UNDER SECTION 5 SHALL NOT BE TREATED AS DAMAGES SUBJECT TO THIS LIMITATION
reasons: Preferred level is incomplete: the redline contains no mutual exclusion of indirect or consequential damages, which the locked preferred position expressly requires.
The fee limb is not anchored to the claim: "IMMEDIATELY PRECEDING 12 MONTHS PERIOD" leaves the measuring point to an unstated event rather than "the 12 months preceding the claim".

Minimality fails: the operation rewrote the entire capitalised sentence (53 words to 106 words; changed-character ratio 0.789), where surgical edits (insert "EITHER PARTY'S", replace the parenthetical carve-out list, add the greater-of limb) plus a short separate insertion would suffice.

All required carve-outs (confidentiality, data protection, security, indemnification, gross negligence, wilful misconduct, fraud, IP infringement) and the payment-obligations carve-out are present and mutual, and the fallback bargain is fully met.

Caution on cross-references: "SECTION 12" (indemnification) and "SECTION 5" (compensation) should be verified against the executed numbering to avoid a dangling reference; deleting the "SECTION 3, 4, 7 AND 11" scope broadens the cap to the whole agreement, which is acceptable given it now runs mutually.
